c1.text: Wherever I go, the Moon follows me!

g1.text: Not chasing, sir: the Moon is very far,

g2.text: Nearby trees and poles fall behind fast...

g3.text: ...but something that far never changes direction.

g4.text: the tree runs, the Moon stays!

c2.text: Does the Sun move with us too?

g5.text: Sir, the Moon is still behind you...
